title: Can AI solve crime?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which types of crime do you think AI could help investigate most effectively?
What is the danger of relying on an algorithm to identify suspicious people?
Should police be allowed to use facial recognition in public places?
Who should be responsible when an AI system falsely accuses someone?
What kind of human oversight should always remain when AI is used in criminal investigations?
